title: About Us
subtitle: Our Studio Story
paragraphs: Dasi Games started with a simple, hyper-focused mission: build games we lose track of time playing. From cooking up our own original IPs to partnering with global publishers and delivering elite outsourcing, we live and breathe interactive entertainment.

Operating from our vibrant studio in the heart of Tbilisi, Georgia, we blend artistic imagination with solid technical engineering. We believe in high-energy collaboration, pixel-perfect polish, and crafting games that resonate with players worldwide.

cards.description: Mobile downloads exceeding 50 million across Google Play and App Store.
Over 28 million web game plays on Poki and other web platforms.
Crafting memorable interactive experiences since our studio's establishment in 2021.
Located in Tbilisi, our creative headquarters serves as our core design and development hub.
